Security headers middleware with production-oriented defaults.Returns the production-safe baseline HelmetOptions used to merge partial user options.Merges options with production-safe defaults, applies disable overrides, and sanitizes header values.Generates a 32-character hex CSP nonce from 16 random bytes, or an empty string if randomness is unavailable.Returns the CSP policy with the nonce directive injected, replacing {nonce} placeholders or extending script-src.Middleware that sets production-oriented security headers on each response from the normalized options.
